mapper.select: SELECT personalization_id, news_id, user_id, user_impact, response_strategy, created_at, updated_at FROM news_report_personalization WHERE news_id = #{newsId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO news_report_personalization (news_id, user_id, user_impact, response_strategy) VALUES (#{newsId}, #{userId}, #{userImpact}, #{responseStrategy})
mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS userId, u.nickname, u.annual_salary AS annualSalary, (SELECT s.total_assets FROM ASSET_SNAPSHOTS s WHERE s.user_id=u.id ORDER BY s.snapshot_month DESC LIMIT 1) AS totalAssets, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN a.account_type='BANK' THEN GREATEST(a.balance,0) ELSE 0 END) FROM ACCOUNTS a JOIN CONNECTIONS c ON c.connection_id=a.connection_id WHERE c.user_id=u.id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL),0) AS depositAssets, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN a.account_type IN ('STOCK','INVESTMENT') THEN GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF(a.eval_amount,0),a.balance),0) ELSE 0 END) FROM ACCOUNTS a JOIN CONNECTIONS c ON c.connection_id=a.connection_id WHERE c.user_id=u.id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL),0) AS investmentAssets, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN a.account_type='LOAN' THEN ABS(a.balance) ELSE 0 END) FROM ACCOUNTS a JOIN CONNECTIONS c ON c.connection_id=a.connection_id WHERE c.user_id=u.id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL),0) AS loanBalance, COALESCE((SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type='INCOME' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END)/3) FROM TRANSACTIONS t WHERE t.user_id=u.id AND t.transaction_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 3 MONTH)),0) AS averageMonthlyIncome, COALESCE((SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type='EXPENSE' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END)/3) FROM TRANSACTIONS t WHERE t.user_id=u.id AND t.transaction_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 3 MONTH)),0) AS averageMonthlyExpense FROM USERS u WHERE u.id = #{userId}
